title.narrative: IRELAND-MALAWI AGRI-FOOD SYSTEMS AND VALUE CHAINS PROGRAM

description.narrative: This is a detailed program design phase of the Ireland-Malawi Agri-Food Systems and Value Chains Program undertaken by Enterprise Ireland through SFSI.The purpose of the assignment is to:• Find the priority developmental needs of Malawi’s food system;• Map out Ireland’s areas of strength and key interests;• Find practical delivery and resource considerations for the future program.The overarching goal of the programme is to contribute to the transformation of Malawi’s food systems for improved livelihoods and resilience to climate, production and consumption shocks through sustainable market-led enterprise and value chain development, food safety institutional and skills development.The farmer training for example will include good agricultural practice, food safety, quality management, climate smart techniques and diversity and inclusionTo ensure the principles of inclusiveness are meaningfully considered, marketing and dissemination will integrate targeting mechanisms tailored to women and youth
